info.bettacraft.alternanthera_reineckii:
A stem plant with deep red leaves; needs strong light.
Plant it in a tank interior on substrate; grows up to the water surface. From a cutting it grows into a plant of many blocks, about 3.5 days to full size with strong light (a lit tank light), nutrients (waste in the water) and 20-30 °C, also while nobody is inside.
Find it: the wandering trader; cuttings from trimming.
Shears: trim it (cuttings), inside or from outside on the tank where you look. Break the root: take the whole plant out. Full-grown it forms side shoots; at the surface it shades the tank.
info.bettacraft.amazon_frogbit:
A floating plant with round leaves and long roots hanging into the water. Males like to build their bubble nest under a cluster of frogbit most of all.
Grows with light and nutrients, forms offshoots and takes up waste.
Find it: the wandering trader sells it, fishing in swamps.
Take plants out: right-click the surface with an empty hand or an aquarium net; net + sneak thins the whole tank out by half.
info.bettacraft.amazon_sword:
A large rosette of long, sword-shaped leaves: the centre piece of a big tank.
Plant it in a tank interior on substrate (the interior floor with a substrate, sand, gravel or dirt). From a cutting it grows into a plant of many blocks, about 7 days to full size with medium light, nutrients (waste in the water) and 20-30 °C, also while nobody is inside.
Find it: the wandering trader; cuttings from trimming.
Shears: trim it (cuttings), inside or from outside on the tank where you look. Break the root: take the whole plant out.
info.bettacraft.anubias_nana:
Dark green, leathery leaves on short stalks; grows very slowly.
Plant it in a tank interior on stone or wood (rocks, roots, decoration). From a cutting it grows into a plant of many blocks, about 25 days to full size with little light, nutrients (waste in the water) and 20-30 °C, also while nobody is inside.
Find it: fishing in jungles and rivers; cuttings from trimming.
Shears: trim it (cuttings), inside or from outside on the tank where you look. Break the root: take the whole plant out. Break a rhizome piece to divide it (half of it as an item).
info.bettacraft.artemia_culture: Hatches into artemia nauplii after one in-game day, but only in light (level 9 or more).
info.bettacraft.artemia_cysts:
Dried brine shrimp eggs, a rare find when you mine sand.
One item lasts for 16 hatcheries.
info.bettacraft.artemia_hatchery:
Hatches artemia nauplii in the light (level 9 or more).
Pour in salt water bottles, add artemia cysts and glass bottles (also by hopper; emptied salt water bottles are reused).
A batch takes 1 day. Take the nauplii with an empty hand or let a hopper below take them.
info.bettacraft.artemia_nauplii: Food for fry in the second half of the fry stage. One bottle feeds 20 fry.
info.bettacraft.betta_bucket:
A betta in a bucket. Use it on a tank to put the fish in (adds 1000 mB water), or on water to release it.
Catch bettas in swamps with a water bucket or a fish bag.
info.bettacraft.betta_pellets:
Everyday food: one pellet feeds up to 4 bettas (juveniles and older).
Right-click a tank with it or put it into a feeder.
info.bettacraft.betta_spawn_egg: Spawns a betta with random domestic genes.
info.bettacraft.bucephalandra_blue:
Dark leaves with a bluish shimmer.
Plant it in a tank interior on stone or wood (rocks, roots, decoration). From a cutting it grows into a plant of many blocks, about 22 days to full size with little light, nutrients (waste in the water) and 20-30 °C, also while nobody is inside.
Find it: rarely when fishing in jungles and rivers; cuttings from trimming.
Shears: trim it (cuttings), inside or from outside on the tank where you look. Break the root: take the whole plant out. Break a rhizome piece to divide it (half of it as an item).
info.bettacraft.bucephalandra_brownie_re:
Brown leaves that turn red under strong light.
Plant it in a tank interior on stone or wood (rocks, roots, decoration). From a cutting it grows into a plant of many blocks, about 22 days to full size with little light, nutrients (waste in the water) and 20-30 °C, also while nobody is inside.
Find it: rarely when fishing in jungles and rivers; cuttings from trimming.
Shears: trim it (cuttings), inside or from outside on the tank where you look. Break the root: take the whole plant out. Break a rhizome piece to divide it (half of it as an item).
info.bettacraft.bucephalandra_green_wavy:
Small wavy green leaves on a compact rhizome.
Plant it in a tank interior on stone or wood (rocks, roots, decoration). From a cutting it grows into a plant of many blocks, about 20 days to full size with little light, nutrients (waste in the water) and 20-30 °C, also while nobody is inside.
Find it: fishing in jungles and rivers; cuttings from trimming.
Shears: trim it (cuttings), inside or from outside on the tank where you look. Break the root: take the whole plant out. Break a rhizome piece to divide it (half of it as an item).
info.bettacraft.bucephalandra_mini_needl:
Narrow, needle-like leaves; stays small.
Plant it in a tank interior on stone or wood (rocks, roots, decoration). From a cutting it grows into a plant of many blocks, about 20 days to full size with little light, nutrients (waste in the water) and 20-30 °C, also while nobody is inside.
Find it: fishing in jungles and rivers; cuttings from trimming.
Shears: trim it (cuttings), inside or from outside on the tank where you look. Break the root: take the whole plant out. Break a rhizome piece to divide it (half of it as an item).
info.bettacraft.cabinet:
Made from any planks. Put a tank on it.
Holds an external filter (with two heaters) and nine stacks the feeder can use.
info.bettacraft.cooler_large: Cools up to 64 water blocks. Place it in the tank interior or into an external filter.
info.bettacraft.cooler_medium: Cools up to 32 water blocks. Place it in the tank interior or into an external filter.
info.bettacraft.cooler_small:
Cools up to 16 water blocks towards the target temperature of the tank when it is warmer around the tank (deserts, the Nether).
Place it in the tank interior (under water) or into an external filter. Coolers add up.
info.bettacraft.cryptocoryne_flamingo:
A rare crypt with whitish pink leaves that get brighter and pinker in strong light; slow.
Plant it in a tank interior on substrate (the interior floor with a substrate, sand, gravel or dirt). From a cutting it grows into a plant of many blocks, about 14 days to full size with medium light, nutrients (waste in the water) and 20-30 °C, also while nobody is inside.
Find it: rarely from the wandering trader; cuttings from trimming.
Shears: trim it (cuttings), inside or from outside on the tank where you look. Break the root: take the whole plant out.
info.bettacraft.cryptocoryne_wendtii_bro:
Brown-red wavy leaves, redder under strong light; sends out runners now and then.
Plant it in a tank interior on substrate (the interior floor with a substrate, sand, gravel or dirt). From a cutting it grows into a plant of many blocks, about 9 days to full size with medium light, nutrients (waste in the water) and 20-30 °C, also while nobody is inside.
Find it: fishing in swamps, sometimes in a bottle of swamp water; cuttings from trimming.
Shears: trim it (cuttings), inside or from outside on the tank where you look. Break the root: take the whole plant out.
info.bettacraft.cryptocoryne_wendtii_gre:
A rosette of green, slightly wavy leaves; sends out runners now and then.
Plant it in a tank interior on substrate (the interior floor with a substrate, sand, gravel or dirt). From a cutting it grows into a plant of many blocks, about 9 days to full size with little light, nutrients (waste in the water) and 20-30 °C, also while nobody is inside.
Find it: fishing in swamps, sometimes in a bottle of swamp water; cuttings from trimming.
Shears: trim it (cuttings), inside or from outside on the tank where you look. Break the root: take the whole plant out.
info.bettacraft.decor:
A decoration structure: places a small build facing you.
Works in a tank interior (it then shows up in the tank in miniature) and anywhere in the world.
info.bettacraft.duckweed:
A floating plant for the water surface of a tank. Use it on a tank: it floats where you look at the water.
Duckweed grows fastest and takes up waste from the water. With light (a lit tank light or daylight) and nutrients (the waste of the animals) it forms offshoots until the surface is covered (60 % by default).
Find it: fill a glass bottle with swamp water (sometimes a bit of duckweed comes up), fishing in swamps.
Take plants out: right-click the surface with an empty hand or an aquarium net; net + sneak thins the whole tank out by half.
info.bettacraft.external_filter:
Place it next to a tank (facing it) or put it into a cabinet under the tank.
Keeps 32 water blocks clean and holds two heaters or coolers of any size.
info.bettacraft.feeder:
Place it on top of a tank and fill it with food (also by hopper).
Feeds 1 to 3 times a day, picks fry food for fry and takes food from cabinets under the tank.
info.bettacraft.fish_bag:
Right-click a small fish to catch it. A bag holds the fish and 100 mB of water.
Use it on a tank to put the fish in, or take a fish out in the tank menu.
Reusable; empty bags stack to 16.
info.bettacraft.heater_large: Heats up to 64 water blocks. Place it in the tank interior or into an external filter.
info.bettacraft.heater_medium: Heats up to 32 water blocks. Place it in the tank interior or into an external filter.
info.bettacraft.heater_small:
Heats up to 16 water blocks towards the target temperature of the tank (default 27 °C).
Place it in the tank interior (under water) or into an external filter. Heaters add up.
info.bettacraft.infusoria: First food for fry. One bottle feeds 20 fry. Hand feeding gives the bottle back.
info.bettacraft.infusoria_culture: Turns into a bottle of infusoria after one in-game day, in your inventory, a chest or on the ground.
info.bettacraft.internal_filter:
Place it in the tank interior: a filter tower with a visible water jet.
While it stands under water it keeps 16 water blocks clean (water quality).
info.bettacraft.java_fern:
A robust fern with long, lance-shaped fronds on a creeping rhizome.
Plant it in a tank interior on stone or wood (rocks, roots, decoration). From a cutting it grows into a plant of many blocks, about 12 days to full size with little light, nutrients (waste in the water) and 20-30 °C, also while nobody is inside.
Find it: fishing in jungles and rivers; cuttings from trimming.
Shears: trim it (cuttings), inside or from outside on the tank where you look. Break the root: take the whole plant out. Break a rhizome piece to divide it (half of it as an item).
info.bettacraft.java_moss:
Fine moss that spreads in a cushion over stone, wood and the floor.
Plant it in a tank interior on any solid block. From a cutting it grows into a plant of many blocks, about 6 days to full size with little light, nutrients (waste in the water) and 20-30 °C, also while nobody is inside.
Find it: shears on a moss block next to water (lush caves); cuttings from trimming.
Shears: trim it (cuttings), inside or from outside on the tank where you look. Break the root: take the whole plant out.
info.bettacraft.larva_tub:
Breeds mosquito larvae under the open sky.
Fill it with a water bucket (or a pipe) and add organic matter: leaves, wheat, rotten flesh or bone meal (also by hopper).
A batch takes about 2 days, faster at night, in swamps and in the rain. Harvest with a glass bottle or let a hopper below take the larvae.
info.bettacraft.ludwigia_repens:
A fast stem plant with copper-red leaves, redder under strong light.
Plant it in a tank interior on substrate; grows up to the water surface. From a cutting it grows into a plant of many blocks, about 3 days to full size with medium light, nutrients (waste in the water) and 20-30 °C, also while nobody is inside.
Find it: fishing in swamps, sometimes in a bottle of swamp water; cuttings from trimming.
Shears: trim it (cuttings), inside or from outside on the tank where you look. Break the root: take the whole plant out. Full-grown it forms side shoots; at the surface it shades the tank.
info.bettacraft.mirror_stick:
Hold the mirror stick in either hand and look at a male betta (up to 6 blocks, also through the glass): it flares at its reflection, holds still and shows the mirror its side (bettas see sideways).
Mirror training: a male that flared at the mirror during the last day gets ready for a bubble nest a little faster (server config, 1.25x by default).
Craft: glass pane, iron nugget and stick, one above the other.
info.bettacraft.monte_carlo:
A carpet of tiny round leaves on the floor; spreads by runners; needs strong light.
Plant it in a tank interior on substrate. From a cutting it grows into a plant of many blocks, about 3 days to full size with strong light (a lit tank light), nutrients (waste in the water) and 20-30 °C, also while nobody is inside.
Find it: the wandering trader; cuttings from trimming.
Shears: trim it (cuttings), inside or from outside on the tank where you look. Break the root: take the whole plant out. Full-grown it sends out runners.
info.bettacraft.mosquito_larvae:
Live food: one portion feeds up to 4 bettas and gets a breeding pair in the mood twice as fast.
From a smelted bottle of swamp water or a larva tub, sometimes from mud mined in a swamp.
info.bettacraft.red_root_floater:
A rare floating plant with small round leaves and red roots. Under strong light (a lit tank light or full daylight) its leaves turn red, under weak light they stay green. Grows slowly.
Find it: rarely from the wandering trader, rarely when fishing in mangrove swamps.
Take plants out: right-click the surface with an empty hand or an aquarium net; net + sneak thins the whole tank out by half.
info.bettacraft.red_tiger_lotus:
Large red, mottled leaves from a tuber; grown up it sends floating leaves to the surface.
Plant it in a tank interior on substrate. From a cutting it grows into a plant of many blocks, about 6 days to full size with medium light, nutrients (waste in the water) and 20-30 °C, also while nobody is inside.
Find it: rarely from the wandering trader; cuttings from trimming.
Shears: trim it (cuttings), inside or from outside on the tank where you look. Break the root: take the whole plant out. The floating leaves shade the tank like floating plants.
info.bettacraft.rotala_rotundifolia:
A fast stem plant with small round leaves; the tips turn pink-red under strong light.
Plant it in a tank interior on substrate; grows up to the water surface. From a cutting it grows into a plant of many blocks, about 2.5 days to full size with strong light (a lit tank light), nutrients (waste in the water) and 20-30 °C, also while nobody is inside.
Find it: fishing in swamps, sometimes in a bottle of swamp water; cuttings from trimming.
Shears: trim it (cuttings), inside or from outside on the tank where you look. Break the root: take the whole plant out. Full-grown it forms side shoots; at the surface it shades the tank.
info.bettacraft.salt_water_bottle: Use a glass bottle on water in an ocean. Mix it with artemia cysts for an artemia hatchery.
info.bettacraft.salvinia:
A robust floating fern with small paired, hairy leaves. Medium growth.
Grows with light and nutrients, forms offshoots and takes up waste.
Find it: the wandering trader sells it, fishing in swamps.
Take plants out: right-click the surface with an empty hand or an aquarium net; net + sneak thins the whole tank out by half.
info.bettacraft.swamp_water_bottle:
Use a glass bottle on water in a swamp.
Smelt it (furnace, smoker or campfire) to hatch mosquito larvae, or mix it with seagrass or leaves for an infusoria culture.
info.bettacraft.tank:
Craft from 6 glass of one kind and 3 iron ingots: the tank shows the texture of that glass, connected across the whole tank.
Clear glass tank: 6 (vanilla) glass, 1 iron nugget in the middle and 3 iron ingots below. A single vanilla-glass tank converts between both styles in the crafting grid.
Place tanks of the same glass and style next to each other to build one large tank of any connected shape (L, T, steps; up to 16x16x16).
Fill it with water buckets: 1 bucket = 1000 mB, from 50% on animals can move in.
Right-click: tank menu. Shift + right-click: enter the interior to decorate it.
info.bettacraft.tank_lid:
Lay it on a top block of a tank: that block no longer loses water by evaporation.
The feeder and lights cover the block they stand on as well.
info.bettacraft.tank_light:
Place it on or above a tank; neighbouring lights join into one bar.
Light level 15. A redstone signal switches the whole bar off.
info.bettacraft.tank_net:
Takes floating plants off the water surface of a tank. Right-click the tank: the plants where you look come out as items, from above as well as from the side through the glass.
Sneak + right-click: thins the whole tank out by half (lily pads stay), like the button on the plants tab of the tank menu.
An empty hand also takes plants out, but only looking down at the surface.
Craft: four string in a square with a stick below on the left.
info.bettacraft.vallisneria:
Long ribbon leaves up to the surface; spreads quickly by runners.
Plant it in a tank interior on substrate; grows up to the water surface. From a cutting it grows into a plant of many blocks, about 2.5 days to full size with medium light, nutrients (waste in the water) and 20-30 °C, also while nobody is inside.
Find it: the wandering trader; cuttings from trimming.
Shears: trim it (cuttings), inside or from outside on the tank where you look. Break the root: take the whole plant out. Full-grown it sends out runners.
